clues.text: Elijah told Ahab to gather all Israel and the prophets of Baal to meet him on this mountain.
Elijah climbed to its summit, bent to the ground, and put his face between his knees while waiting for rain.
A lover praising his beloved says her head crowns her like this mountain, her hair like purple threads.
Prophesying against Egypt, Jeremiah said one would come like Tabor among the mountains and like this one by the sea.
The Shunammite woman went to Elisha at this mountain, and he saw her coming from a distance.
Elisha went on to this mountain, and from there he returned to Samaria.
Through Amos, God warned that even those who hid atop this mountain would be tracked down and seized.
